title: 5분만 더
style: bright upbeat Korean city pop funk, 1980s retro groove, slap bass, crisp funky electric guitar, punchy brass section stabs, handclaps, tight disco drums, one man sings alone: a deep low male baritone voice in his late 40s, warm chest voice in a low comfortable range, singing cheerfully with a playful humorous tone, the same man from start to end, catchy bouncy chorus, comedic morning rush, energetic and fun
lyrics:
[Verse]
알람이 울리면 오 분만 더
눈 떠 보니 벌써 여덟 시 반
양말은 짝짝이 넥타이 어디
토스트 물고서 뛰어간다

[Chorus]
달려라 달려라 월요일 아침
엘리베이터는 왜 꼭대기에
버스는 방금 떠나 버렸고
부장님은 오늘도 일찍 왔다

[Outro]
그래도 오늘을 버텨 낸 너
오늘 밤엔 푹 자게 해 줄게
note: Song 8 (first upbeat track, 2026-11-24 direction: 70% bright/upbeat, 30% ballad; relatable tragicomic 웃픈 situations). Monday morning rush: snooze, mismatched socks, toast in mouth, elevator on the top floor, bus just left, the boss already in. Hook at 1 s: 알람이 울리면 오 분만 더. Killing part: 달려라 달려라 월요일 아침. Twist: a warm last line. Numbers spelled as sung (오 분, 여덟 시) so they are sung right. Voice = MC02 male solo, no female/choir/falsetto. | 2026-11-28: user picked v3 but still hears a female voice. Root cause: ACE-Step runs at guidance 1.0, so 'no female vocals, no falsetto' in the style pulled a female voice/falsetto in (song.py now strips 'no X' phrases). Repaint pass 1: 15-37 s (flags 17-35 s, '양말' heard as '옛날'); pass 2 will be 56-66 s. | pass 1 (MC08-1128-0204) v2 kept for 0-31.6 s (verse + chorus heard right, no high flags) -> assets/MC08_p1.mp3; pass 2 redoes 31.6-66 s (the 37 s boundary had garbled '그래도 오늘을 버텨' into '떠나 버렸고', and a high '영원히' ad-lib at 58-64 s).

extend.caption: the same deep low male baritone man sings the chorus once more in his low chest voice: 버스는 방금 떠나 버렸고, 부장님은 오늘도 일찍 왔다, then warmly and slowly the last two lines: 그래도 오늘을 버텨 낸 너, 오늘 밤엔 푹 자게 해 줄게, then the band plays a short bright instrumental ending and stops
